name: Addus HomeCare Corp.
summary:
Addus HomeCare (ADUS) reported earnings of $1.73 per share on revenue of $377.42 million for the second quarter ended June 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $1.68 per share on revenue of $375.33 million. The Earnings Whisper number was $1.74 per share. The company missed expectations by 0.57% while revenue grew 8.01% on a year-over-year basis.

Addus HomeCare Corp provides home and community based services, which are mainly social in nature and are provided in the home, focused on the dual eligible population.
subject: Addus HomeCare Missed Expectations
